implementation: Guidance-only operation category covers createTodo/createDaily/createHabit/updateTask. Exact initiating intent authorizes the matching internal-preview acceptance under existing consent; no redundant agent approval exchange is mandated.
Task descriptions, packaged skill, deadline reference and discovery corpus agree. Ambiguous identity/input, unexpected effects and consequential-action reviews remain separate.

MCP input schemas, honest write/destructive annotations, scopes, server authorization/revision/identity guards and original receipt recovery remain unchanged. No skip-confirmation argument or alternate acceptance path was introduced.
limitations: Local synthetic services and metadata/package qualification only; real model activation, conversational question counts and native host permission prompts remain unmeasured.
No actual task/account mutation, new grant/consent, executor activation, package installation, deployment or commit was performed.
Host safeguards remain authoritative. Pending/unknown projection is never reported as confirmed Habitica presence or rewards.
Active controller time was not instrumented; per-control tool wall time is retained separately.
